title: Moss Makes a Home
note: b416 — Phase 5 continues (School readiness) — new split digraphs o-e, u-e.

pages.brief: Moss the hedgehog standing at the base of the big oak tree, looking up at a low hollow.
Moss the hedgehog noticing a small gap near the base of the oak tree trunk.
Moss the hedgehog carrying a small stick towards the gap in the oak.
Moss the hedgehog carrying a clump of soft green moss towards the gap.
Moss the hedgehog carrying a broad dry leaf towards the gap in the oak.
Moss the hedgehog arranging the stick, moss and leaf snugly inside the gap.
A cosy little hollow lined softly with moss, a leaf and a stick.
Moss the hedgehog curled up contentedly inside his new home.
Moss the hedgehog sleeping peacefully inside the snug hollow.
Moss the hedgehog peeking happily out of the entrance to his new home.
